study type: Trend analysis of three cross-sectional studies
cohort: Over 29,000 mothers in Egypt who gave birth in the five years preceding the 2005, 2008, and 2014 Egypt Demographic and Health Surveys (EDHS)
finding: Results showed a steady rise in c-sections in Egypt that has reached an alarming level in recent years, particularly associated with a shift towards delivery in private health care facilities.
